context: Kenji helps Ren run an automation tool.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech help; vocabulary (補助/かける/動作/させる/送ら) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この自動化、どう動かすんですか?
lines.en: How do I run this automation?
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm focused throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 補助ツールを使えば、簡単に動作します。
lines.en: With the helper tool, it runs easily.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一気に、全部動作させられますか?
lines.en: Can I run it all at once?
lines.style: curious young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、順に動作させましょう。
lines.en: Yes, let's run it in sequence.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結果は、メールで送らせますか?
lines.en: Shall I have it send results by email?
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 自動で送らせれば、手間が省けます。
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: チェックに、時間をかけたいです。
lines.en: I want to spend time on the check.
lines.style: reliable young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 補助があれば、安心して動作させられます。
lines.en: With the helper, you can run it with confidence.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
